Compile the pinned GET /v1beta/models binding and project the two response descriptors. Use Protobuf JSON names, scalar formats and repeated arrays without requiring fields in responses.

adaptations.change: Use oneOf for separate model and agent forms; prohibit both identifiers and require agent input.
Require id, created, updated and steps on full HTTP responses, not on partial lifecycle event payloads.
Use published lowercase thinking_level and thinking_summaries enums, not the SDK's open-string reader fallback.
Use the seven published event_type variants, not the SDK's client-only UNKNOWN fallback. Each tag is distinct.
Require documented string code and message; wrap the inner SDK error as an HTTP error object.
